svg.title: Gold cycle-window pin sets v2: Set A (6 approved pins) and the algorithmic 20 on GLD closes, +-45d scoring windows
svg.desc: IN-SAMPLE. Every pin on this chart is a close-based turning point of GLD-USD, read from the close column (column index 1 is open). The +-45d bands are a SCORING TARGET for the Stage A indicator-weight search — they are NOT execution periods, they carry NO exposure floor, and they say nothing about time in market. Set A was chosen by looking at this same series. Nothing here is a performance claim: no return, no Sharpe, no trade count. Regenerate: digiquant/scripts/plot_gold_pin_sets_v2.py
svg.text: Gold cycle-window pin sets v2: Set A (6 approved pins) and the algorithmic 20 on GLD closes, +-45d scoring windows

gold_v1() = 6 close-based pins, owner-approved and detector-corroborated at 0-bar offsets | gold_v2() = 20 turns from detect_turns at min_move_pct=15.0, the level selected by capture depth 15.7457 (vs 10.6792 / 7.1547)
Set A ±45d bands (strong, bar at panel foot) over the 20-turn gold_v2() wash (faint)
buy / sell alternation · P = peak (sell side), T = trough (buy side) · vertical tick = the turn is also in Set A
strictly alternating peak/trough, every peak paired; Set A ⊆ gold_v2(), same kinds

a SCORING TARGET for the Stage A indicator-weight search — they are NOT execution periods, they carry NO exposure floor, and they say nothing about

source: GLD-USD.csv close column / 26 pins drawn
